# WordPress MCP Server

> A free WordPress plugin by miniOrange that turns a WordPress site into a secure MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini can then read and manage the site through chat, using 483 tools, within role-based permissions the site owner sets. Every action is checked against WordPress capabilities and logged. No coding is needed.

MCP endpoint (same for every site): https://gateway.miniorange.ai/v2/mcp
Transport: Streamable HTTP. Authentication: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. During sign-in, the user enters their WordPress site address on the miniOrange Gateway page, then logs in to their own WordPress site and clicks "Allow access".

Before connecting, the site owner must: install the plugin from WordPress.org (slug: miniorange-secure-mcp-server), create and enable an agent in Secure MCP Server -> AI Agents, and grant tools to their user role. The site must be public HTTPS (not localhost) and run WordPress 6.9+ and PHP 7.4+.

The tools cover posts, pages, block-by-block editing, media, comments, menus, widgets, users, settings, maintenance, safe theme editing (draft, preview, automatic rollback), WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Rank Math, Advanced Custom Fields, Elementor, Kadence Blocks, Divi (Pro plan), Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms and Fluent Forms. Governed REST API access lets the AI call other plugins' REST routes under per-role permissions.
